answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 16469 Country: India Title: assalamu alaikum is it permit able to brush the teeth by using pepsodent or any other paste at the time of fasting. Question: assalamu alaikum is it permit able to brush the teeth by using pepsodent or any other paste at the time of fasting. Answer ID: 16469 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1613/1285/L=1430) It is makrooh to use Pepsodent or any tooth paste during fast, and if its particles went inside mouth, it will break the sawm. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
